facts.claim_en: Arizona law gives the landlord fourteen days, not counting weekends or legal holidays, after the tenancy ends, possession is returned and the tenant asks, to provide an itemized list of deductions.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Arizona da al arrendador catorce días, sin contar fines de semana ni feriados, después de terminar el contrato, entregar la vivienda y la solicitud del inquilino, para dar una lista detallada de descuentos.
facts.source_name: Arizona Revised Statutes 33-1321, Security deposits
facts.quote: Within fourteen days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays or other legal holidays, after termination of the tenancy and delivery of possession and demand by the tenant the landlord shall provide the tenant an itemi

facts.claim_en: Arizona law limits a security deposit, including prepaid rent, to one and one-half month's rent.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Arizona limita el depósito, incluida la renta pagada por adelantado, a un mes y medio de renta.
facts.source_name: Arizona Revised Statutes 33-1321, Security deposits
facts.quote: A landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, including prepaid rent in an amount or value of more than one and one-half month's rent.

facts.claim_en: Connecticut law says the landlord must return the deposit, or the balance with a written list of damages, within twenty-one days after the tenancy ends or fifteen days after getting the tenant's forwarding address, whichever is later.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Connecticut dice que el arrendador debe devolver el depósito, o el saldo con una lista escrita de daños, dentro de veintiún días después de terminar el contrato o quince días después de recibir la dirección nueva del inquilino, lo que sea más tarde.
facts.source_name: Connecticut General Statutes, Chapter 831 (Section 47a-21)
facts.quote: Not later than twenty-one days after termination of a tenancy or fifteen days after receiving written notification of such tenant's forwarding address, whichever is later

facts.claim_en: Connecticut law limits the deposit for a tenant under sixty-two to two months' rent.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Connecticut limita el depósito de un inquilino menor de sesenta y dos años a dos meses de renta.
facts.source_name: Connecticut General Statutes, Chapter 831 (Section 47a-21)
facts.quote: In the case of a tenant under sixty-two years of age, a landlord shall not demand a security deposit in an amount that exceeds two months' rent.

facts.claim_en: D.C. law says that within 45 days after the tenancy ends, the housing provider must tell the tenant in writing of any amounts it claims.
facts.claim_es: La ley de D.C. dice que dentro de 45 días después de terminar el contrato, el arrendador debe avisar por escrito al inquilino de cualquier monto que reclame.
facts.source_name: D.C. Code 42-3502.17, Security deposits
facts.quote: Within 45 days after termination of the tenancy, the housing provider shall notify the tenant in writing

facts.claim_en: D.C. law says the notice must include photographs or other documentation supporting the housing provider's claim.
facts.claim_es: La ley de D.C. dice que el aviso debe incluir fotografías u otros documentos que respalden el reclamo del arrendador.
facts.source_name: D.C. Code 42-3502.17, Security deposits

facts.claim_en: Delaware law says that within 20 days after the rental agreement ends, the landlord must give the tenant an itemized list of damages and pay the difference.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Delaware dice que dentro de 20 días después de terminar el contrato, el arrendador debe dar al inquilino una lista detallada de daños y pagar la diferencia.
facts.source_name: Delaware Code, Title 25, Chapter 55 (Section 5514)
facts.quote: Within 20 days after the termination or expiration of any rental agreement, the landlord shall provide the tenant with an itemized list of damages

facts.claim_en: Delaware law says a landlord who does not return the deposit or the difference within 20 days owes the tenant double the amount wrongfully withheld.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Delaware dice que el arrendador que no devuelve el depósito o la diferencia dentro de 20 días debe al inquilino el doble de lo retenido sin derecho.
facts.source_name: Delaware Code, Title 25, Chapter 55 (Section 5514)
facts.quote: within 20 days from the expiration or termination of the rental agreement shall entitle the tenant to double the amount wrongfully withheld

facts.claim_en: Florida law says that if the landlord does not intend to claim against the deposit, it must be returned within 15 days after the rental agreement ends.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Florida dice que si el arrendador no piensa reclamar contra el depósito, debe devolverlo dentro de 15 días después de terminar el contrato.
facts.source_name: Florida Statutes 83.49, Deposit money or advance rent
facts.quote: the landlord must return the security deposit, together with interest if otherwise required, within 15 days after the termination of the rental agreement

facts.claim_en: Florida law says a landlord who intends to claim against the deposit must send written notice within 30 days after the rental agreement ends.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Florida dice que el arrendador que piensa reclamar contra el depósito debe enviar un aviso escrito dentro de 30 días después de terminar el contrato.
facts.source_name: Florida Statutes 83.49, Deposit money or advance rent
facts.quote: If the landlord intends to impose a claim on the deposit, the landlord must, within 30 days after the termination of the rental agreement, provide the tenant written notice

facts.claim_en: Iowa law says the landlord must return the deposit, or give a written statement of the reasons for keeping any of it, within thirty days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives a mailing address.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Iowa dice que el arrendador debe devolver el depósito, o dar por escrito las razones para quedarse con una parte, dentro de treinta días después de terminar el contrato y de recibir la dirección del inquilino.
facts.source_name: Iowa Code 562A.12, Rental deposits
facts.quote: A landlord shall, within thirty days from the date of termination of the tenancy and receipt of the tenant’s mailing address or delivery instructions, return the rental deposit to the tenant

facts.source_name: Iowa Code 562A.12, Rental deposits
facts.quote: A landlord shall not demand or receive as a security deposit an amount or value in excess of two months’ rent.

facts.claim_en: Idaho law says refunds are due within twenty-one days if the agreement sets no time, and in any event within thirty days after the tenant gives up the premises.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Idaho dice que los reembolsos se deben dentro de veintiún días si el contrato no fija un plazo, y en todo caso dentro de treinta días después de que el inquilino entrega la vivienda.
facts.source_name: Idaho Code 6-321, Security deposits
facts.quote: Refunds shall be made within twenty-one (21) days if no time is fixed by agreement and, in any event, within thirty (30) days after surrender of the premises by the tenant.

facts.claim_en: Idaho law describes ordinary wear as use without negligence, carelessness, accident, misuse or abuse.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Idaho describe el desgaste normal como el uso sin negligencia, descuido, accidente, mal uso ni abuso.
facts.source_name: Idaho Code 6-321, Security deposits
facts.quote: without negligence, carelessness, accident, or misuse or abuse of the premises or contents by the tenant

facts.claim_en: Kansas law says the landlord must return the balance within 14 days after deciding on deductions, and in no event more than 30 days after the tenancy ends, possession is returned and the tenant asks.

facts.quote: the landlord shall return the balance of the security deposit to the tenant within 14 days after the determination of the amount of such expenses, damages or other charges, but in no event to exceed 30 days after termination of the tenancy, delivery of possession and demand by the tenant

facts.claim_en: Kansas law limits the deposit for an unfurnished home to one month's rent.

facts.source_name: Kansas Statutes 58-2550, Security deposits
facts.quote: A landlord may not demand or receive a security deposit for an unfurnished dwelling unit in an amount or value in excess of one month's periodic rent.

facts.claim_en: North Dakota law says an itemized list with the amount due must be delivered or mailed to the tenant within thirty days after the lease ends and possession is returned.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Dakota del Norte dice que una lista detallada con el monto debido se debe entregar o enviar al inquilino dentro de treinta días después de terminar el contrato y entregar la vivienda.
facts.source_name: North Dakota Century Code, Chapter 47-16 (Section 47-16-07.1)
facts.quote: along with a written notice within thirty days after termination of the lease and delivery of possession by the lessee

facts.claim_en: North Dakota law generally limits a security deposit to one month's rent.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Dakota del Norte limita en general el depósito a un mes de renta.
facts.source_name: North Dakota Century Code, Chapter 47-16 (Section 47-16-07.1)
facts.quote: A lessor may not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of one month's rent

facts.claim_en: Nebraska law says the balance and a written itemization must be delivered or mailed to the tenant within fourteen days after the tenancy ends.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Nebraska dice que el saldo y una lista escrita detallada se deben entregar o enviar al inquilino dentro de catorce días después de terminar el contrato.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Revised Statutes 76-1416, Security deposits
facts.quote: The balance, if any, and a written itemization shall be delivered or mailed to the tenant within fourteen days after the date of termination of the tenancy.

facts.claim_en: Nebraska law limits a security deposit to one month's rent, plus a pet deposit of up to one-fourth of a month's rent.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Nebraska limita el depósito a un mes de renta, más un depósito por mascota de hasta un cuarto de mes de renta.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Revised Statutes 76-1416, Security deposits
facts.quote: A landlord may not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of one month's periodic rent, except that a pet deposit not in excess of one-fourth of one month's periodic rent may be demanded

facts.claim_en: New Hampshire law says the landlord must return the deposit, with any interest due, within 30 days after the tenancy ends.
facts.claim_es: La ley de New Hampshire dice que el arrendador debe devolver el depósito, con los intereses que correspondan, dentro de 30 días después de terminar el contrato.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire RSA 540-A:7, Return of security deposits
facts.quote: a landlord shall return a security deposit to a tenant and pay the interest due, if any, within 30 days from the termination of the tenancy.

facts.claim_en: New Hampshire law says the landlord must give a written, itemized list of any damages claimed, and that reasonable wear and tear is excluded.
facts.claim_es: La ley de New Hampshire dice que el arrendador debe dar una lista escrita y detallada de los daños que reclama, y que se excluye el desgaste razonable.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire RSA 540-A:7, Return of security deposits
facts.quote: If there are any damages to the premises, excluding reasonable wear and tear, the landlord may deduct the costs of repair from the security deposit. The landlord shall provide the tenant with a written, itemized list of any damages

facts.claim_en: Nevada law says the landlord must give an itemized, written accounting and return any remaining deposit no later than 30 days after the tenancy ends.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Nevada dice que el arrendador debe dar una cuenta escrita y detallada y devolver el resto del depósito a más tardar 30 días después de terminar el contrato.
facts.source_name: Nevada Revised Statutes, Chapter 118A (NRS 118A.242)
facts.quote: return any remaining portion of the security deposit to the tenant no later than 30 days after the termination of the tenancy

facts.claim_en: Nevada law says a landlord who fails or refuses to return the remaining deposit within 30 days is liable to the tenant for damages.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Nevada dice que el arrendador que no devuelve o se niega a devolver el resto del depósito dentro de 30 días responde ante el inquilino por daños.
facts.source_name: Nevada Revised Statutes, Chapter 118A (NRS 118A.242)
facts.quote: If the landlord fails or refuses to return the remainder of a security deposit within 30 days after the end of a tenancy, the landlord is liable to the tenant for damages

facts.claim_en: New York law says that within fourteen days after the tenant moves out, the landlord must give an itemized statement of anything kept and return the rest.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Nueva York dice que dentro de catorce días después de que el inquilino se va, el arrendador debe dar una declaración detallada de lo que retiene y devolver el resto.

facts.quote: Within fourteen days after the tenant has vacated the premises, the landlord shall provide the tenant with an itemized statement indicating the basis for the amount of the deposit retained

facts.claim_en: New York law says a landlord who misses the fourteen-day deadline forfeits any right to keep part of the deposit.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Nueva York dice que el arrendador que no cumple el plazo de catorce días pierde el derecho a quedarse con parte del depósito.
facts.source_name: New York General Obligations Law 7-108
facts.quote: If a landlord fails to provide the tenant with the statement and deposit within fourteen days, the landlord shall forfeit any right to retain any portion of the deposit.

facts.claim_en: Ohio law says any deduction must be itemized in a written notice delivered with the amount due within thirty days after the rental agreement ends and possession is returned.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Ohio dice que cada descuento se debe detallar en un aviso escrito entregado con el monto debido dentro de treinta días después de terminar el contrato y entregar la vivienda.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code 5321.16, Procedures for security deposits
facts.quote: Any deduction from the security deposit shall be itemized and identified by the landlord in a written notice delivered to the tenant together with the amount due, within thirty days after termination of the rental agreement

facts.claim_en: Ohio law lets a tenant recover damages equal to the amount wrongfully withheld, plus reasonable attorney's fees.

facts.claim_en: Oregon law says that to claim any of the deposit, the landlord must give a written accounting within 31 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant returns possession.

facts.claim_en: Rhode Island law says the landlord must deliver the notice and the amount due within twenty (20) days after the tenancy ends, possession is returned or the tenant gives a forwarding address, whichever is later.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Rhode Island dice que el arrendador debe entregar el aviso y el monto debido dentro de veinte (20) días después de terminar el contrato, entregar la vivienda o dar la dirección nueva, lo que sea más tarde.

facts.claim_en: South Carolina law says deductions must be itemized in a written notice with the amount due within thirty days after the tenancy ends, possession is returned and the tenant asks.

facts.claim_en: South Carolina law says a tenant may recover three times the amount wrongfully withheld, plus reasonable attorney's fees, if the landlord fails to return it with the notice.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Carolina del Sur dice que el inquilino puede recuperar tres veces el monto retenido sin derecho, más honorarios razonables de abogado, si el arrendador no lo devuelve con el aviso.
facts.source_name: South Carolina Code, Title 27, Chapter 40 (Section 27-40-410)

facts.claim_en: South Dakota law says the landlord must return the deposit, or give a written statement of the specific reasons for keeping any of it, within twenty-one days after the tenancy ends and the tenant gives a mailing address.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Dakota del Sur dice que el arrendador debe devolver el depósito, o dar por escrito las razones específicas para retener una parte, dentro de veintiún días después de terminar el contrato y de recibir la dirección del inquilino.

facts.quote: Every lessor of residential premises shall, within twenty-one days after the termination of the tenancy and receipt of the tenant's mailing address or delivery instructions, return the security deposit

facts.claim_en: South Dakota law says that within forty-five days after the tenancy ends, if the tenant asks, the landlord must give an itemized accounting of any deposit withheld.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Dakota del Sur dice que dentro de cuarenta y cinco días después de terminar el contrato, si el inquilino lo pide, el arrendador debe dar una cuenta detallada del depósito retenido.
facts.source_name: South Dakota Codified Laws 43-32-24
facts.quote: Within forty-five days after termination of the tenancy, upon request of the lessee, the lessor must provide the lessee with an itemized accounting of any deposit withheld.

facts.claim_en: The Texas Attorney General says the landlord must return the deposit, less any deductions for damages, within 30 days.
facts.claim_es: El Fiscal General de Texas dice que el arrendador debe devolver el depósito, menos los descuentos por daños, dentro de 30 días.
facts.source_name: Texas Attorney General: Renters' rights
facts.quote: The landlord must return your deposit — less any amount deducted for damages — within 30 days.

facts.claim_en: The Texas Attorney General says to give the landlord your new address in writing, and to contact the landlord if no deposit or explanation arrives within 30 days.
facts.claim_es: El Fiscal General de Texas dice que dé al arrendador su dirección nueva por escrito, y que lo contacte si no recibe el depósito ni una explicación dentro de 30 días.
facts.source_name: Texas Attorney General: Renters' rights

facts.claim_en: Virginia law says the deposit and any deductions must be itemized in a written notice within 45 days after the tenancy ends or the tenant moves out, whichever is last.

facts.claim_en: Wyoming law says the balance and a written itemization of deductions must be delivered or mailed within thirty (30) days after the rental agreement ends, or fifteen (15) days after receiving the renter's new address, whichever is later.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Wyoming dice que el saldo y una lista escrita de descuentos se deben entregar o enviar dentro de treinta (30) días después de terminar el contrato, o quince (15) días después de recibir la dirección nueva, lo que sea más tarde.
facts.source_name: Wyoming Statutes, Title 1 (Section 1-21-1208)
facts.quote: shall be delivered or mailed without interest to the renter within thirty (30) days after termination of the rental agreement or within fifteen (15) days after receipt of the renter's new mailing address, whichever is later

facts.claim_en: Wyoming law says a utilities deposit must be refunded within ten (10) days of a satisfactory showing that utility charges were paid.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Wyoming dice que un depósito de servicios se debe reembolsar dentro de diez (10) días después de mostrar que se pagaron los servicios.
facts.source_name: Wyoming Statutes, Title 1 (Section 1-21-1208)
facts.quote: shall be refunded by the owner to the renter within ten (10) days of a satisfactory showing that all utility charges incurred by the renter have been paid

facts.claim_en: USAGov says to read your lease carefully before getting outside help with a dispute with your landlord.
facts.claim_es: USAGov dice que lea su contrato con cuidado antes de buscar ayuda externa para una disputa con su arrendador.
facts.source_name: USAGov: How to file a complaint against a landlord
facts.quote: Before getting outside help, read your lease carefully.

facts.claim_en: USAGov says you may decide you need help from a lawyer to settle a dispute with your landlord, and points to legal aid.
facts.claim_es: USAGov dice que usted puede decidir que necesita la ayuda de un abogado para resolver una disputa con su arrendador, e indica dónde buscar ayuda legal.
facts.source_name: USAGov: How to file a complaint against a landlord
facts.quote: You may decide that you need help from a lawyer to settle the dispute with your landlord.
